svg.title: Research: five papers on arXiv, each with the engine command behind it
svg.desc: Research built on the open engine: five papers on arXiv, each with the command that regenerates its numbers. arXiv:2606.22054 (2026-06-20, eess.SP): Anticipating the Optimism Gap: Predicting Distribution-Shift Degradation of RF-Impairment Detectors from In-Distribution Statistics; regenerate: cargo run --release --example optimism_study. arXiv:2606.24210 (2026-06-23, eess.SP): A Conditional Timing Protection Level: Holdover-Limited Undetected Time Error Under GNSS Spoofing; regenerate: cargo run --release --example tpl_jammertest. arXiv:2607.05415 (2026-06-22, cs.CR): How Stable Is a PNT Resilience Score? Decision-Instability of Single-Number Resilience Ratings under Framework-Aligned Weighting; regenerate: cargo run --release --example resilience_report. arXiv:2607.02566 (2026-06-29, eess.SP): Earth-baseline VLBI restores the observability of a lunar surface station in joint orbit-and-clock determination; engine kind: kshana example lunar-joint-od-clock. arXiv:2607.06212 (2026-07-07, astro-ph.EP): The Cost of Lunar South-Polar Geometry, and Surface Beacons as the Efficient Fix: A Dilution-of-Precision Analysis; engine kind: kshana example lunar-beacon.
